finding.statement: On the stratum B_3 the tetragonal pencil is canonically recovered from the marked curve, so the two candidate automorphism groups coincide and the C66-GEO-COMP rigidity statement can be made for the M_{6,6}-relevant group. Concretely, for Γ in the incidence one has O(Γ)≅L relatively, hence M:=ω_C(-Γ)≅ω_C⊗L^{-1}=ω_C²⊗W_5^∨; under the weak CE relative-canonical normalization (FND-0105, ATT-0066/CLM-0066-2) M≅γ*O_{P¹}(1), which is base-point-free of degree 4, and on B_3 one has h⁰(L)=3 hence h⁰(M)=2, so |M| is a base-point-free PENCIL and equals the pencil defining γ; therefore γ is determined by (C,Γ) up to PGL_2. Consequently any σ∈Aut(C) with σ(Γ)=Γ satisfies σ*M≅M, preserves |M|, and induces τ∈PGL_2 with γσ=τγ, i.e. Aut(C,Γ)=Aut(C,γ,Γ) on B_3, and the deck-transformation rigidity argument (three distinct marked images plus one γ-étale marked point) applies verbatim to Aut(C,Γ). The recovery fails on B_4, where h⁰(M)=3 and |M| is a net containing many pencils.
